The '''blackback''' was an elusive [[Forest/Legends|forest]]-dwelling [[Bird/Legends|bird]] of [[Diet/Legends|prey]] that lived in the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]] and other protected regions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The birds were a popular [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] prize, though they were well-protected by the [[Chandrilan House|Chandrilan government]] after their near-extinction. Blackbacks' diet consisted of [[Squall (species)|squalls]] and other small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]], which they sometimes hunted while circling thermal vents.

==Biology and appearance==
Blackbacks were [[Bird/Legends|birds]] of [[Diet/Legends|prey]] that lived within the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. Their wingspan was over five [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behavior==
Elusive and carnivorous creatures, blackbacks hunted [[Squall (species)|squalls]] and small [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]]. The birds often circled the thermal vents in Chandrila's [[Crystal Canyons]], where they stalked prey and, on occasion, bothered climbers.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
Prior to the construction of Chandrila's many [[Farm/Legends|farms]], blackbacks roamed over much of the planet. However, because the birds were seen as valuable [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trophies, they were nearly hunted to extinction hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a result, Chandrila's squall population increased dramatically, endangering crops. Eventually, the blackback was protected by the [[Chandrilan House|Chandrilan government]] and allowed to roam large preserves, such as the [[Hanna Wild Game Reserve]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], blackbacks in the Hanna Wild Game Reserve were hunted by [[ghorla]]-riding hunters. In order to be able to participate in the hunt, one required a permit that cost more than 200,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Death/Legends|kill]], a sum that was used by the Chandrilans to fund [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] programs for the birds. During the Empire's [[Blockade on Chandrila|blockade]] of Chandrila, all such permits were suspended except for those belonging to Imperial officials.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blackback was first mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
